## 1. Scope

Phase 0 design covers the **three implemented bounded contexts** plus the **Shared Kernel B** event vocabulary:

| Bounded context | Code today | Design artefact |
|---|---|---|
| Tutoring | `src/study_tutor/session/`, `src/study_tutor/mcp/adapter.py` | [contracts/API-tutoring.md](contracts/API-tutoring.md), [models/DM-tutoring.md](models/DM-tutoring.md) |
| Inference Runtime | `src/study_tutor/llm/client.py` | [contracts/API-inference-runtime.md](contracts/API-inference-runtime.md), [models/DM-inference-runtime.md](models/DM-inference-runtime.md) |
| MCP Transport | `src/study_tutor/mcp/`, `scripts/mcp-wrapper.sh` | [contracts/API-mcp-transport.md](contracts/API-mcp-transport.md), [models/DM-mcp-transport.md](models/DM-mcp-transport.md) |
| Shared Kernel B (Events) | reserved (CC-11); P1 wire-up | [events-schema.yaml](events-schema.yaml) |

**Phase 0 protocol surfaces:** MCP stdio + CLI + in-process Events. No REST, no GraphQL, no A2A, no ACP per ADR-ARCH-008.

**Deferred contexts (re-run `/system-design --focus="<name>"` per phase):**

| Context | Phase | Recommended re-run trigger |
|---|---|---|
| Knowledge & Curriculum | P1 | After `phase-1-scope.md` is finalised + Graphiti spike produces latency numbers |
| Student Model | P1 | After `phase-1-scope.md` and the Graphiti split topology (ADR-ARCH-007) is operational |
| Gamification | P2 | When the gamification engine moves from `docs/gamification/design.md` to runtime code (per ADR-ARCH-013) |

The full re-run command set is in [`phase-0-build-plan.md` § "GuardKit Command Sequence"](../research/ideas/phase-0-build-plan.md#guardkit-command-sequence).

## 3. Design decisions captured

### 2026-04-26 pass

| ID | Decision | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| **D1** | Tutoring data model documents the **Phase-0 shape only** (`session_id, subject, topic, status, turns, started_at, ended_at`). P1 fields deferred. | Matches live `tutor_session.py` dataclasses; avoids contract-drift before P1 implementation. |
| **D2** | `tutor_start_session` classified **`sync`** (not `long-running`). | Live behaviour: returns `session_id` synchronously; warm-up is fire-and-forget, not a polled task. **Closed 2026-04-27 by [ADR-ARCH-017](../architecture/decisions/ADR-ARCH-017-tutor-start-session-sync-classification.md)** (partially supersedes ADR-ARCH-008 SR-07 table); downstream artefacts (`domain-model.md §7.1`, `phase-0-scope.md §SR-07`, `container.md`, MCP adapter/server code) all updated. |

Both 2026-04-26 decisions are recorded in [`phase-0-build-plan.md` punch-list item 7](../research/ideas/phase-0-build-plan.md). D1 remains a design-only decision (no architectural lift); D2 is now superseded at the architectural level by ADR-ARCH-017.

### 2026-04-27 MCP Transport refresh

| ID | Decision | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| **[DDR-001](decisions/DDR-001-mcp-descriptions-do-not-enumerate-graphiti-writes.md)** | MCP tool description strings (registered via `FastMCP.add_tool(...)`) **do not enumerate Graphiti write side-effects**, even after CC-13 broadens fire-and-forget writes to every write point in `tutor_turn` and `tutor_session_end`. Enforced by recommended substring test (I-MCP9). | SR-07 says tool description ≡ user-visible contract. CC-13 / ARCH-019 commit to async-from-caller for every write; failures are log-only. The 78.98s `add_episode` median ([latency spike](../research/ideas/graphiti-latency-spike-results.md)) makes any hint at "Graphiti persistence" actively misleading — there is no protocol affordance for an integrator to wait on it. The honest description is silence. |

### 2026-04-27 Tutoring refresh

| ID | Decision | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| **[DDR-002](decisions/DDR-002-coach-async-subagent-owns-graphiti-writes.md)** | The Coach `AsyncSubAgent` owns its own Graphiti writes for misconception observations (flush point F1). The Tutor handler dispatches the planner topic-confidence write (F2) and the session-end episode (F3). All three flush points route through one shared Graphiti write helper; no aggregation, no batching. | ARCH-019 settled *whether* writes are async (yes, every site) and *what failure mode* applies (log-only); it did not pin *who* dispatches each write. DDR-002 assigns ownership in a way that prevents accidental session-scoped buffering being added later — the very alternative ARCH-019 §Alternatives explicitly rejected. With `add_episode` median 78.98s, per-observation per-task dispatch is also the shape that minimises per-crash data loss. |
| **[DDR-003](decisions/DDR-003-session-completed-emits-on-state-transition.md)** | Shared Kernel B Tutoring events (`session.started`, `session.turn_completed`, `session.completed`) emit on the relevant state transition, **not** on Graphiti write success. The events bus and the Graphiti write helper are independent persistence/notification surfaces with independent failure modes. | Coupling event emit to write success would re-introduce a synchronous Graphiti dependency one step removed from the MCP handler — exactly the shape CC-13 forbids. With 78.98s median write latency, subscribers would wait ~79s after `tutor_session_end` returns. The events bus is at-most-once and consumer-facing; the Graphiti episode is a parallel artefact. Symmetric with DDR-001 (writes invisible at MCP description) and DDR-002 (writes invisible to other components' control flow). |

### 2026-04-27 Inference Runtime refresh (PM late)

| ID | Decision | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| **[DDR-004](decisions/DDR-004-num-ctx-modelfile-owned-not-client.md)** | `num_ctx` is owned by the Ollama Modelfile, **not** by `LLMClient`. The client does not set `options.num_ctx` per request; only `options.num_predict` is set per request via `OLLAMA_NUM_PREDICT` (default 2048; CC-14 floor 1500). CC-14 conformance is enforced by a two-part smoke test: `ollama show <model> --modelfile \| grep PARAMETER` *and* runner-log inspection of `llama_new_context_with_model: n_ctx = N` from a real inference call. | ADR-ARCH-018 promoted SR-09 to CC-14 but did not pin *where* the rule lives in the codebase. `num_ctx` is a per-model, model-load-time concern (KV-cache allocation) — not a per-request tuning knob. The persona split documented in [openwebui-rag-empirical-findings §3e](../research/ideas/openwebui-rag-empirical-findings-2026-04-23.md) (Shakespeare persona = no RAG, Modern Texts persona = RAG mandatory) means `num_ctx` is a deployment decision, not a request decision. The empirical failure mode (silent mid-word truncation, [§2 Finding 4](../research/ideas/openwebui-rag-empirical-findings-2026-04-23.md)) cannot be detected by the client — only the runner log proves the loaded model saw the intended value. Symmetric with DDR-001 / DDR-002 / DDR-003 (CC-14 invariants live where the regression class is — outside the request path), which keeps `LLMClient` simple and the anti-corruption layer faithful to its `ARCHITECTURE.md §3` role. |

## 4. Out-of-scope artefacts (and why)

| Artefact | Why omitted |
|---|---|
| `openapi.yaml` | No REST surface in Phase 0. ADR-ARCH-008 makes MCP-only the agent contract; Open WebUI consumes Ollama directly. Re-introduce when (and if) HTTP transport lands. |
| `a2a-schemas.yaml` | No agent-to-agent contract — Study Tutor is a single agent, not a multi-agent system. Re-evaluate if Reachy (P2 stretch) gains a delegating role. |
| `acp-workflows.yaml` | No agent communication protocol surface. Same reason. |
| C4 L3 component diagrams | Phase-0 containers all have ≤ 3 internal components. The threshold (>3, per `/system-design` Step 5 rule) is not met for Inference Runtime or MCP Transport. **Inference Runtime re-confirmed ≤ 3 components in the 2026-04-27 PM-late refresh** (`LLMClient` + provider-resolution helpers + lazy `httpx`-on-Ollama path; the Modelfile is a configuration artefact, not an internal component). **Tutoring crossed it in the 2026-04-27 PM refresh** (8 internal components: SessionStore, TutorSession aggregate, Tutor Player, Coach AsyncSubAgent, Session Planner, RAG Retriever wrapper, Graphiti Write Helper, Events emitter) — see [diagrams/tutoring-c4-l3.md](diagrams/tutoring-c4-l3.md). |

**2026-04-26 pass:** ✓ No contradictions detected against the 16 architecture ADRs. The protocol set (MCP + CLI + Events) is congruent with ADR-ARCH-008 and ADR-ARCH-014. The Bedrock route classification matches ADR-ARCH-006. The async Events bus matches ADR-ARCH-003 and CC-11.

**2026-04-27 MCP Transport refresh:** ✓ No contradictions detected against the 19 architecture ADRs (now including ADR-ARCH-017 / ADR-ARCH-018 / ADR-ARCH-019). All five deltas applied (Δ1 ADR-017 wording, Δ2 CC-13 + CC-14 added to invariants list, Δ3 ARCH-019 every-write-point broadening, Δ4 latency-spike anchoring, Δ5 `mcp-tools.json` description refresh) are *consistent* with the new ADRs — each resolves a stale reference rather than introducing one. DDR-001 is a *design-level* refinement of how SR-07 surfaces under CC-13; it does not change any architectural commitment.

**2026-04-27 Tutoring refresh:** ✓ No contradictions detected against the 19 architecture ADRs. Ten deltas applied (Δ1 D2→ADR-017, Δ2 `tutor_turn` mid-session writes, Δ3 `tutor_session_end` ARCH-003→ARCH-019, Δ4 events §5.3 decoupling, Δ5 §7 conformance tests + cross-context pointers, Δ6 §9 open questions refresh, Δ7 §5 persistence multi-flush narrative, Δ8 I-T7 invariant + CC-14 pointer, Δ9 §11 flush-points table + §9 conditional `flush_history`, Δ10 events-schema rationale ARCH-003→ARCH-019). DDR-002 and DDR-003 are *design-level* refinements that pin ownership and event timing under ARCH-019 / CC-13; both resolve open ARCH-019 follow-ups rather than introducing new architectural commitments. The C4 L3 diagram for Tutoring is generated and approved at the mandatory review gate.

**2026-04-27 Inference Runtime refresh (PM late):** ✓ No contradictions detected against the 19 architecture ADRs. Five deltas applied (Δ1 §4 split into 4.1 client-resident / 4.2 Modelfile-resident, Δ2 invariants I-IR6 / I-IR7 added for CC-14, Δ3 §7.2 CC-14 smoke-test row + client-payload smoke row, Δ4 §8 per-request `num_ctx` out of scope + non-Ollama-CC-14 out of scope, Δ5 §9 open question on CC-14 extension to non-Ollama providers; same five deltas mirrored in `DM-inference-runtime.md`). DDR-004 is a *design-level* refinement that pins the Modelfile-vs-client locus for CC-14 conformance under ADR-ARCH-018; it resolves the *where does the rule live* question that ADR-ARCH-018 deliberately left to the design layer. Inference Runtime confirmed ≤ 3 internal components — no C4 L3 diagram required. **This run closes the last outstanding stale-reference item from ADR-ARCH-018 / ADR-ARCH-019.**

## 6. Conformance: design ↔ live code

The artefacts in this directory are deliberately **descriptive of live code**, not aspirational. Every contract / data-model file pin-cites the source file + line range. When code drifts:

- A pure additive change (new field, new event consumer) → update the artefact and re-run `/system-design --focus="<context>"`.
- A breaking change (rename, classification flip, removed `error_type`) → run `/design-refine` first; do not silently edit the artefact.
